readerCopy.body: A big opportunity can still belong to an old chapter. Jupiter conjunct the South Node can enlarge a familiar role, belief, audience, market, or path you already know how to navigate. The offer may be generous, the praise may be sincere, and the scale may make returning feel like obvious progress. Bigger is not automatically newer. Look at what the opportunity expands in practice. It can be worth taking if it turns old experience into leverage, but not if it simply gives the old pattern more room.
